architecture: supervised MLP head trained on DINOv2-small 384d mean patch embeddings; backbone unchanged
embedding: mean non-CLS patch tokens; L2 normalized; training uses full frame and center-square crop; app inference uses multi-scale views
sourceDataset: FabNet-3k v1.0.0, CC BY 4.0, 5 textile material classes; images are fabric samples/product photos, not sofa-only upholstery photos
validationMethod: stratified 20% image holdout; product-series near-duplicates may remain across split; not a sofa-photo benchmark
